{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:45.920
    | text      = So the news that Alex is kind of dancing around, and he does bring up, but not in these clips, is that Vance Bolter left behind a letter that was meant to be sent to Kaush Patel at the FBI.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:32:56.920
    | text      = In which he claimed that he'd carried out the assassinations on behalf of Tim Walz, who wanted him to kill Amy Klobuchar so Walz could take her Senate seat.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:05.920

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:07.920
    | text      = This letter was later released in a search warrant, those filed to get access to blink security camera data, and it doesn't necessarily come off as entirely credible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:15.920
    | text      = He claims to have been secretly trained by the military since he was in college, and that he was involved in a bunch of secret unspecified projects, which is pretty standard stuff for these types of folks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:24.920
    | text      = Unverifiable, unfalsifiable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:27.920
    | text      = Yeah, they build up a self-mythology that follows archetypal beats, but it doesn't include anything specific.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:33.920
    | text      = The idea is supposed to be that this stuff that they were involved in is so secret, and they're such good soldiers that they would never reveal these secrets, but that premise is shaky.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:42.920
    | text      = Why maintain that kind of secrecy when you're writing a letter to the head of the FBI where you admit to murders and an elaborate plot involving the governor?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:33:49.920
    | text      = I think that some of the coverage of this letter has been a little bit off, because the impression that you might get is that Tim Walz enlisted Bolter to kill a bunch of Democratic politicians, including Amy Klobuchar, and that the two assassinations that he attempted to carry out were the beginning of that plan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:07.920
    | text      = I think that's the impression that a lot of people get.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:10.920
    | text      = Right, that they're trying to, yeah, okay, I got you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:13.920
    | text      = The assassinations were part of the plot that Walz put in place through Bolter.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Right, right, right, right.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:19.920

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:27.920
    | text      = From his letter, quote, recently I was approached about a project that Tim Walz wanted done, and blank, and Keith, also left blank, but it's clearly Keith Ellison, they were aware of the project.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:38.920
    | text      = Tim wanted me to kill Amy Klobuchar, it's misspelled, and Tina, blank, but it's obviously Smith, the other Minnesota senator.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:48.920
    | text      = Tim wants to be senator and he doesn't trust blank to retire as planned and thinks she's going to stay on at the last minute.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:34:55.920
    | text      = Bolter is telling the story that Walz wanted him to kill these two senators so that he could take one of their seats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:00.920
    | text      = Melissa Hortman and John Hoffman aren't targets from Walz at all in his telling of the story through this letter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:08.920
    | text      = His letter goes on, quote, I told Tim I wanted nothing to do with it and if he didn't call off the plan I would go to the public.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:15.920

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:27.920

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:35.920
    | text      = It's not a situation where I feel comfortable filling in all the blanks that Bolter left in his note, but I am confident that Mel refers to Melissa Hortman and that the story he's trying to tell is that Hortman and Walz and a third unnamed person confronted Bolter with this plan saying that he needed to follow through with it or else they would hurt his family.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:35:54.920
    | text      = Bolter didn't want to go along with it so he returned and shot at two unnamed people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:00.920
    | text      = That leads me to suspect the unnamed people are Hortman and John Hoffman, which implies that Hoffman is supposed to be the third person who was at this meeting that Bolter claimed he had with Walz where they were threatening him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:12.920
    | text      = If you follow the train of thinking in this letter that he left, he didn't kill Hortman and try to kill Hoffman because Walz wanted him to.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:20.920
    | text      = He was a desperate man who was being threatened by Walz and the entire power structure of the Minnesota government and he was living out the plot of an action movie.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:28.920
    | text      = This distinction doesn't really matter in the real world because Bolter isn't telling a true story here, but the stuff that we look at is all about narrative.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:36.920

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:00.920

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
